name: CO2 site model far
description: Invented two-orbital donor-acceptor model of CO2 on an open metal site (teaching model, not ab initio). Two electrons; Jordan-Wigner, spin orbitals [C_up, M_up, C_down, M_down]. e_exact is the ground energy in the one-up, one-down sector (the physical answer); e_min_full_matrix is the lowest eigenvalue of the whole 16x16 matrix, which belongs to a 3-electron state.
